source_note: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则
english_source_note: Liouville Principles for Holomorphic and Meromorphic Functions
callout_id: 揭露全纯以及亚纯函数信息的Liouville原则#5
statement_en: Let \(\ho>0\). An entire function satisfies the growth estimate $$f(z)=O\\bigl(e^{|z|^{\ho}}\\bigr)$$ and for every \(n>3\) one has $$f(\\log n)=0.$$ Prove that \(f\\equiv 0\).
key_techniques: zero set rigidity for entire functions
construction of an auxiliary function with prescribed zeros
prerequisites: order and growth of entire functions
callout_body: $\rho >0$整函数有上界估计$f(z) = O(e^{|z|^{\rho}})$并且对于$n>3$都有$f(\log(n))=0$。证明整函数是0.
